response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"HTML, 1 Corinthians 15:19 quotation","severity":"major","source_quote":"If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable","suggested_fix":"Revise the quotation to preserve the conditional meaning “if our hope in Christ is only for this life” and the resulting state of being “most pitiable,” for example: “Kama tumaini letu katika Kristo ni la maisha haya tu, sisi tu wa kusikitikiwa kuliko watu wote.”","translation_quote":"Kama katika maisha haya tu tunamtumaini Kristo, sisi ni wa kusikitikiwa kuliko watu wote"},{"location":"HTML, numbered point 2","severity":"major","source_quote":"Each of us WILL fall into temptations","suggested_fix":"Change “tutaangukia” to a faithful equivalent of falling into temptation/trials, such as “atakumbwa na majaribu,” preserving that each person will encounter them.","translation_quote":"Kila mmoja wetu ATAANGUKIA katika majaribu"},{"location":"HTML, closing paragraph, final sentence","severity":"major","source_quote":"our Abba Father","suggested_fix":"Translate “Abba Father” as “Baba yetu Abba” (or another clear Kiswahili rendering that retains the intimate address “Abba”), rather than leaving the substantive title untranslated.","translation_quote":"Baba yetu Abba"}],"passed":false,"score":88}
